observation.command:
cd /workspace; ls ~/.pub-cache/hosted/pub.dev 2>/dev/null | wc -l; cat .dart_tool/package_config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "package_config present"; export PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64; nohup flutter build apk --debug --flavor ni --dart-define=PARTNER=ni --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 &
echo "build pid $!"
